data.one_liner: A multi-directional tooltip widget with arbitrary content and built-in list view support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a flexible tooltip widget that can be positioned along any axis and supports arbitrary content. It automatically falls back to the opposite side if overflowed and includes support for list views.
use_when: You need a tooltip that can contain arbitrary widgets rather than simple text.
You require multi-directional tooltip positioning with automatic overflow fallback.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Flutter Tooltip widget functionality.
You want a complete UI kit rather than a single-purpose widget.
strengths: Supports arbitrary content inside the tooltip.
Handles overflow and positioning across multiple axes automatically.
Works inside ListViews and follows targets through scrolling.
weaknesses: API is subject to change according to documentation.
data.minimal_example:
JustTheTooltip(
  child: const Icon(Icons.add),
  content: const Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
    child: Text('Tooltip content'),
  ),
)
